emma (DevEx): heads-up from onboarding: users can't tell whether to retry on 401 vs 403; SDKs and sampleapps inconsistent.
tai (SDK): seen it. node sampleapp returns a blob with no http code.
hao (PM): quick rule: 401 -> try refresh then retry; 403 -> permission issue, do not retry. but customers need explicit hints.
lina (eng): propose a compact envelope emitted by API and surfaced by SDKs: error_type, code, message, http_status, retry_policy, hint, retry_after (opt), trace_id. keep message short; details go to logs.
tai (SDK): plan: typed errors in each SDK with helper predicates isRetryable()/StatusCode()/Code() and a legacy shim controlled by REDWOOD_LEGACY_ERRORS.
hao (PM): include retry_policy enum: none, idempotent_only, safe, always. add hint like "refresh token" or "request scope:inference.write".
lina (eng): server-side add auth-proxy normalization for IdP oddities (403 that means expired token) and emit normalized_http_status in telemetry. include trace_id for support.
emma (DevEx): sampleapp changes: emit the new envelope by default and update onboarding quickstarts with a tiny decision table. keep examples short.
ops-bot: scheduled rollout window: 2026-04-08 02:00 UTC :rocket:
tai (SDK): i'll open SDK PRs with tests mapping 401/403/429/5xx and a compatibility shim.
lina (eng): i'll add proxy rules and trace_id emission.
hao (PM): i'll update the onboarding docs and add an FAQ "When should I retry?".
emma (DevEx): thumbs? tai/lina/hao?
tai (SDK): :thumbsup:
lina (eng): :thumbsup:
hao (PM): :thumbsup:
emma (DevEx): thanks team — should cut support loops and make DX parity across languages.
